## `errors`

### `errors.refusal.sessionBusyError`

This session is busy. Stop it or let it finish, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.sessionDeletingError`

This session is being deleted. If it's still here, delete it again.

### `errors.refusal.sessionArchivedError`

This session is archived. Resume it to send a message.

### `errors.refusal.sessionNotRunningError`

This session isn't running. Resume it, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.sendInProgressError`

A message is already on its way to this session from another window. Try again once it's sent.

### `errors.refusal.sendStoppedError`

You stopped this message before it was sent.

### `errors.refusal.backendUnnamedError`

This session is still starting. Try again in a moment.

### `errors.refusal.recordGoneError`

The backend no longer has a record of this session. Start a new session to go on.

### `errors.refusal.openElsewhereError`

#### `one`

This session is open in another program, process {ids}. Close it there, then try again.

#### `other`

This session is open in other programs, processes {ids}. Close them there, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.openElsewhereUnnamedError`

This session is open in another program. Close it there, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.openUnknownError`

Ersa can't tell whether another program has this session open. Close any that might, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.noFinishedReplyError`

This session can be forked once a reply finishes.

### `errors.refusal.backendCannotForkError`

This session's backend can't fork sessions. Updating the backend may help.

### `errors.refusal.folderGoneError`

This session's folder no longer exists. Put the folder back, then try again.

### `errors.refusal.branchGoneError`

The branch or commit this session's folder had checked out no longer exists, so the folder can't be put back. Start a new session to go on.

### `errors.refusal.branchInUseError`

This session's branch is checked out in another folder. Switch that folder to another branch, then try again.
